programmes.d: Things take a gruesome turn when Ferrabees Circus comes to town.
When a corporate giant tries to acquire a small but respected relish factory owned and run by a dysfunctional family, a naked body is found in the warehouse.
A man is killed after the winner of an urban myth competition gains a cult following, and myth becomes reality
Joyce talks Barnaby into enrolling in a spa located in a remodeled manor house but the bodies start to pile up when he's there.
An outcast who was acquitted of murder years previously, comes under suspicion when more murders take place.
A member is killed with a golf club on the Whiteoaks Golf Course. During the investigation, Barnaby discovers Whiteoaks to be full of hatred, gambling, violence, jealousy, and extortion.
DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are called in to investigate a possible death by poisoning.
Cyclist Greg Eddon is murdered after winning the local leg of a national race, beating teammate Mitch McCordell at the last minute.
A scarecrow festival takes a grisly turn when dead bodies are found staged like the straw creations.
A body is found on the eve of a psychic fayre. Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.
An amateur opera company is in the middle of rehearsals when a dead body is found in the theatre.
A gifted young pianist with emotional issues is in competition with other young talents for a scholarship to a prestigious private musical academy.
Barnaby must step into the spiritual world of mediums, psychics, and occult followers to find a killer.
Barnaby is implicated in a murder when a photo of him in a passionate embrace with another woman is displayed shortly before the woman’s estranged photographer husband is strangled.
The unveiling of a newly-discovered novel by deceased Midsomer crime-writer George Summersbee is jeopardised.
When the body of a local beauty is discovered by the pool at her manor house, Barnaby and Troy uncover a seedy world of adultery and deceit within the affluent rural community.
A pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks.
Local bootleggers come under suspicion after the disappearance of a government inspector.
Could a ballad made famous by late, lamented folk singer Johnny Carver be an inspiration for murder?
Fox hunting, taxidermy, and Oscar Wilde are part of the backdrop as Barnaby and Troy investigate a series of murders, beginning with that of a tramp in the woods.
The fizz goes out of a sparkling wine launch when the glasses are laced with poison.
When an arrogant aristocratic family's decision to develop a memorial garden into a commercial tea shop has the villagers up in arms, murders past and present rear their heads.
Deep in Blacktrees Forest is a bombproof shelter, at which a doomsday prepper group meets weekly.
When King's family enterprise shatters into pieces and its accountant winds up stabbed, Barnaby digs into rivalries of business and blood, while Jones explores secret Masonic rites.
Barnaby is called in when a new arrival to a tight-knit community for retired police officers is found dead.
A pet detective is found dead in the kennel of a dog he was looking for.
A trendy organic bakery in a restored mill is at the centre of a local dispute which leads to a death.
Barnaby is not impressed when Sarah drags him to a wedding. But things go from bad to worse when he must unveil a murderer with an apparent penchant for local brides.
A Parish chairwoman is found dead in a local theatre, possibly because of her hostility toward a drag show.
